==Black/Blues==
It seems there might be some dispute over whether the [[Blue Ajah]] has a high or low concentration of [[Black Ajah|Black]] sisters. I don't want to edit that it's a high percentage if someone's just going to re-edit back that it's not. So, if you look at [[Verin Mathwin|Verin]]'s list about the Black Ajah:
*48 are [[Red Ajah|Red]] (so about a quarter of Reds are Black which we can assume is probably the highest percentage)
*38 are [[Green Ajah|Green]]
*20 are [[Gray Ajah|Gray]] (so logically the Gray has the smallest percentage of Blacks)
*28 are [[Brown Ajah|Brown]]
*21 are [[Yellow Ajah|Yellow]]
*21 are Blue (presumably quite a high percentage because the Blue is so small)
*17 are [[White Ajah|White]] (also presumably quite a high percentage because the White is so small)
It seems obvious that the Blue Ajah has quite a high concentration of Black sisters, because while it is the second-smallest [[Ajah]], is does not have the second-smallest number of Black sisters. And personally, I've always thought that due to the very nature of what the Blue Ajah is and does, that it would be the perfect Ajah for a Black sister to hide in - though that of course is just purely my opinion. Thoughts?
